description: The newest recorded edits to Polymarket and Kalshi market rules, newest first, each with the removed and added words, the Yes price at the edit and a link. Filter by venue, kind of edit, category or title words. Use it for questions like "what rules changed this week" or "any new Kalshi clarifications".

before_id.description: For the next page: the next_before_id from the previous answer.

category.description: Only markets in this category. Leave out for all.

kind.description: Only this kind of edit: clarification (text added to settle a case), rules (rules text edited), source (resolution source changed), dispute (Polymarket outcome disputed), dates (end date moved), title (title changed). Leave out for all of them.

limit.description: How many edits to return, 1 to 20. Default 10.

query.description: Only edits on markets whose title holds these words, as a phrase, like "Fed" or "Senate". Leave out for every market.

venue.description: Only edits on this venue: pm (or polymarket) or kalshi. Leave out for both.

name: recent_rule_changes
title: Recent rule changes
